chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: He narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Sindi ibn Muhammad, who said:

A group of people were following Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him). He turned to them and said, 'What is your state?' They said, 'We are your Shia, O Amir al-Mu'minin.' He said, 'Why do I not see the mark of the Shia upon you?' They asked, 'And what is the mark of the Shia?' He said: 'Yellowish faces from staying awake (in worship), hollowed bellies from fasting, dry lips from supplication, and the dust of the humble/submissive upon them.'
ai.seo_question: What are the physical signs of true Shia followers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the physical and spiritual characteristics of true followers (Shia) through their outward appearance, which reflects their inner devotion. These marks include pale faces from night prayers, hollowed stomachs from fasting, and dry lips from constant supplication, all covered in the dust of humility.

en.badr-shahin: My father, Allah may have mercy upon him, narrated to us from Mohammed bin Ahmed bin Ali bin as-Salt from Ahmed bin Mohammed from as-Sindi bin Mohammed that

Amir ul-Mu’minin (a) turned his face to the group who were following him and asked them about their beliefs. “We are your Shia, Amir ul-Mu’minin,” they answered. He said, “But I cannot see the marks of the Shia on your faces.” “What are the marks of the Shia?” asked they. He (a) spoke: The Shia are pale-faced because of staying up at nights, atrophied-stomached because of fasting, and dry-lipped because of prayers to Allah. The dust of the submissive covers them.
